page-display.purpose: The start page's one h1, "Sing the first line. / The words appear."; balanced wrapping; the vh term keeps the button above the fold.

page-headline.purpose: The example's heading on the start page, centred.

page-lede.purpose: The one sentence under the start page's h1, Soft Charcoal, max 30em, balanced.

display.purpose: The sung lines, Charcoal, 400, left-aligned; sized per bhajan to the largest that fits between the slide's rules (18px to 110px), one sung line per row.

headline.purpose: The bhajan's name and pitch "(ladies / gents)", bold and centred over a 2px Rule Grey rule.

meaning.purpose: The English meaning in italics, Soft Charcoal, over the slide's closing 2px rule.

body.purpose: One-sentence status under the listen button, Soft Charcoal; also the search field.

label.purpose: Choice pills, panel rows and search results. Search pill 15px / 500; wordmark 19px / 700 / -0.02em.

note.purpose: Caption hint, panel notes, figure captions, search lines, in Quiet Charcoal; footer 13px. Inline lyric cues use 0.5em of the lyric size at 500.

key.purpose: Keycap letters; 12px in Soft Charcoal inside the search pill.

shortcut.purpose: Shortcut labels beside their keycaps on the start page, 15px Soft Charcoal; hidden on touch screens.

shadows.name: button-lift
shadows.purpose: The round listen button; removed when disabled.

shadows.name: glass-float
shadows.purpose: Volunteer panel and search sheet, with backdrop-filter: blur(30px) saturate(1.3).

shadows.name: screen-lift
shadows.purpose: The start page's preview screen only.

shadows.name: bar-edge
shadows.purpose: The top bar once scrolled, over rgba(253, 248, 232, 0.92) with backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(1.4).

shadows.name: ring-outline
shadows.purpose: Listening rings over a transparent background; inset 0 0 0 2px #5c5c5c once singing is heard. Never filled.

motion.name: glide
motion.purpose: iOS-like, no overshoot. Things that move: button glides and dock, hover/press, panel and sheet pop, the start page settling away.

motion.name: arrive
motion.purpose: Exponential ease-out. Things that appear: page headline and lede, cycle, title, lyric lines, meaning, rings, fills, caption, download arc, the slide leaving.

motion.name: button-handoff
motion.value: inline -> lifting (2 frames, no transition) -> floating (0.95s glide) ... landing (0.95s glide to the slot) -> inline
motion.purpose: The one listen button leaves the start page's slot for the fixed layer and returns to it; focus follows.

motion.name: dock
motion.purpose: Button glides to bottom centre after the first lines start arriving.

motion.name: page-clear
motion.purpose: The start page clears when listening starts; returns with opacity 0.45s.

motion.name: page-enter
motion.value: h1 rise 1.05s arrive at 0, lede at 0.12s, cycle fade 1s at 0.3s

motion.name: lyric-rise
motion.value: 1.05s arrive; title at 0ms, first line 260ms, 90ms stagger, meaning 120ms after the last line
motion.purpose: Each element rises 0.4em and sharpens from a 14px blur, once.

motion.name: slide-leave
motion.purpose: The whole slide fades and blurs 10px.

motion.name: download-arc
motion.purpose: The progress ring around the waiting button.

motion.name: ripple
motion.value: 3s arrive, 3 rings 1s apart, from 90% opacity to 1.85x, in a layer at 70% that fades over 0.5s
motion.purpose: Listening; gone by 70% of the cycle. Never restarted: the layer fades in and out.

motion.name: hearing
motion.value: ring layer to 100%, rings to Quiet Charcoal over 0.6s; bars scaleY 1 to 0.45, 0.9s alternate
motion.purpose: Singing heard; same ring rhythm. Bars ease back to rest over 0.4s when it stops.

motion.name: pop
motion.purpose: Volunteer panel and search sheet open.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: No glides, page scale, rings or bars; one static ring at 50% and 1.35x; headline, lede, title, lyrics and meaning fade over 0.5s; the slide leaves with a plain fade.

slide.rule: 2px solid #9e9e9e, under the title and under the meaning, full slide width
slide.lyricsFit: bisection to the largest size that fits; max min(20% stage height, 7.5% stage width, 110px); min 18px; wrap below 40px (26px under 640px stage width); the preview never wraps
slide.preview: container units inside a 16:10 screen (1:1 below 640px): inset 6cqh 6cqw; title clamp(12px, 3.4cqw, 44px); meaning clamp(9px, 1.5cqw, 19px)

page.hero: min-height calc(100svh - 64px); statement, 132px button slot, 64px caption space, cycle (max 980px) over a 2px rule, More cue
page.dividers: 2px Rule Grey opens a group; 1px hairline rgba(51, 51, 51, 0.12) between rows

narrative.overview:
AutoBhajan puts up the slide the Sai centre already projects, by the user's explicit choice, from a reference slide they shared: a warm cream page, charcoal type and grey rules. The bhajan's name and its pitch sit bold and centred over a rule, the romanised lyrics are left-aligned below in regular weight, and the English meaning closes the slide in italics over a second rule. The room already knows how to read this layout. The same cream, charcoal and grey carry the whole app, start page included, again by the user's choice. Around the slide the app is Apple canon: a start page in the voice of an Apple product page (tight 700 headlines, soft-charcoal ledes, generous air), one round charcoal button that listens, Shazam-style rings, lines that rise out of a blur as in Apple Music's lyrics view, and motion that glides and never bounces. It is executed straight, with no concept world, texture or ornament, and no colour beyond the slide's own.

There are two densities. The start page says what the app does once, and then shows it: a sticky bar with the wordmark and search, a headline, one sentence, and the listen button with its caption; on scroll, a real bhajan set in a screen under one heading, a single line of keyboard shortcuts, and the source. No explanatory blurbs. The moment listening starts, the page clears and the screen holds only what the room needs this second: the button and its grey rings, then the slide with the button docked small beneath it. Everything the volunteer might need beyond that (home, search, other matches, what was heard, full screen) sits in quiet shaded circles in the bottom-right corner. The slide's scale is set for a projector read from the back of a hall by an audience that skews older.

The system is light only (`color-scheme: light`, theme colour cream). Charcoal on cream holds about 11.9:1, so the words stay strong on a washed-out projector.
keyCharacteristics: Warm cream page, charcoal type, grey 2px rules, everywhere; no other hue.
The slide: bold centred title with pitch over a rule, left-aligned regular-weight lyrics, italic meaning over a closing rule.
Lyrics sized to fill the space between the rules, one sung line per row.
One solid charcoal object: the round listen button.
One system type stack (SF Pro on Apple devices); page headlines are 700 and tightly tracked, the sung words are 400.
The button is one object that sits in the page, lifts out, glides to the middle, docks under the slide and lands back.
Glide and exponential ease-out motion; nothing overshoots, nothing moves while people sing.

rules.name: The Slide Palette Rule
rules.body: Cream, charcoal and grey only, on every surface, the start page included. No accent hue, no gradient wash, no glow, no tinted band.

rules.name: The One Solid Rule
rules.body: The round listen button is the only solid charcoal object. Everything else is type, a rule, a hairline, a 7% shade or cream glass.

rules.name: The Grey Is A Line Rule
rules.body: Rule Grey and Hairline draw lines and ring outlines only. Text starts at Quiet Charcoal.

rules.name: The Page Voice Rule
rules.body: Start-page statements are 700 with tight tracking (-0.025em to -0.03em) and balanced wrapping. The slide never borrows that tracking: its title is -0.01em and its lyrics -0.005em.

rules.name: The Say It Once Rule
rules.body: The start page says what the app does once (the headline and one sentence) and then shows it (the example slide). No step-by-step explainer, no feature blurbs, no repeated call to action; anything the button's caption or the slide already says is not said again.

rules.name: The One Line, One Row Rule
rules.body: Every sung line sits on a single row so singers see where a line ends. Wrapping is a last resort: only when the one-row fit would fall below 40px (26px on stages under 640px wide) do long lines wrap, at line-height 1.1 with a 0.5em gap between sung lines. The start page's example never wraps.

rules.name: The Largest That Fits Rule
rules.body: Lyric size is never a fixed step on a scale; it is the largest size at which the whole bhajan fits between the title rule and the meaning. Only outliers that overflow even at 18px with wrapping scroll, inside the stage, fading out at the bottom edge.

rules.name: The Slide Weights Rule
rules.body: On the slide the title is 700, the sung words 400, the meaning 400 italic in Soft Charcoal. The lyrics are never bold.

rules.name: The Button Keeps The Middle Rule
rules.body: On the start page's first screen the listen button sits near the middle, under the statement; nothing above it may push it below the fold.

rules.name: The Nothing Else Rule
rules.body: Once listening starts, and in the found state, the screen shows only the button (and its rings), the slide (title, rule, words, meaning, rule) and the corner circles. No header bar, no list, no progress bar. The start page is the only place with a bar, sections or explanation.

rules.name: The Slide Order Rule
rules.body: Title and pitch, rule, lyrics, meaning, rule: always in that order, always inside the slide's margins. The lyrics take whatever height the title and meaning leave.

rules.name: The No Boxes Rule
rules.body: The start page has no cards, boxes or tinted bands; the preview screen is the one framed object, because it depicts a screen.

rules.name: The Lifted Few Rule
rules.body: Only the listen button, the glass sheets and the preview screen cast shadows. The slide, every rule, pills and corner circles are flat.

rules.name: The Outline Ring Rule
rules.body: Listening rings and the download ring are 2px outlines only, never filled.

rules.name: The One Button Rule
rules.body: There is one listen button, and it travels: page slot, centre, dock, and back. It is never duplicated: the start page has no second listen control.

rules.name: The Words First Rule
rules.body: When a bhajan is found, the button leaves the middle at once (no delay: a waiting button read as lag) while the title rises and the first lyric line follows at 260ms. The room's eye goes to the words, not to the control.

rules.name: The No Snap Rule
rules.body: Nothing on the button starts or stops mid-motion. The rings run at one steady rhythm inside a layer that fades in and out; hearing changes their colour and strength, never their timing; the bars start from rest and ease back to it. A snapping button reads as jitter.

rules.name: The Still While Singing Rule
rules.body: Motion happens only at the change from one bhajan to the next. Once the meaning has arrived, nothing on screen moves.

dos: **Do** keep every surface, start page included, Slide Cream (`#fdf8e8`) with Charcoal (`#333333`) type and Rule Grey (`#9e9e9e`) rules, and keep the system light only.
**Do** lay out every found bhajan as the slide: bold centred title with "(ladies / gents)" pitch over a 2px rule, left-aligned lyrics, italic meaning over a closing 2px rule.
**Do** set lyrics at 400, at the largest size that fits between the rules, one sung line per row, wrapping only below the 40px / 26px floor.
**Do** keep the slide inside its side margins (clamp(20px, 5.5vw, 120px)) and above the dock band, so the docked button never sits on the words.
**Do** keep the listen button near the middle of the start page's first screen, under one statement.
**Do** write start-page headings at 700 with tight tracking (-0.025em to -0.03em).
**Do** say each thing on the start page once, and show the slide rather than describe it.
**Do** make every secondary control a translucent charcoal Shade circle or pill, deepening to Shade Deeper on hover.
**Do** use a 2px Charcoal outline, 4px out, as the focus ring on every control.
**Do** use Glide for movement and Arrive for appearance; let the lyrics arrive before the docked button moves, and the meaning after the last line.
**Do** keep listening rings inside the space between the button and its caption; they must be invisible by the time they reach the text.
**Do** swap every large movement for a crossfade under reduced motion.
donts: **Don't** add a dark theme, a white or tinted ground, or any accent hue; the Sai Samathee blue, saffron and ray orange, the blue glow and the saffron warmth are retired.
**Don't** colour any word: titles and lyrics are Charcoal, ledes and the meaning Soft Charcoal.
**Don't** bold or centre the lyrics; weight and centring belong to the title.
**Don't** use Rule Grey or Hairline for text, or set any text below Quiet Charcoal.
**Don't** add vertical rules, boxes, cards or header bars around the slide; its two horizontal rules are its only lines.
**Don't** put cards, tinted bands or boxed panels on the start page; groups are divided by rules alone.
**Don't** use solid charcoal for anything but the round listen button.
**Don't** add explainer steps, feature blurbs or a second call to listen to the start page.
**Don't** show the start page's bar, sections or explanations once listening starts.
**Don't** fill the listening rings or the download ring.
**Don't** add overshoot to movement; the glide is a critically damped curve and arrivals ease out exponentially.
**Don't** animate anything while the bhajan is being sung.
**Don't** shrink lyrics to a fixed small size to fit a long bhajan before trying one-row fitting, then wrapping.
**Don't** put logos, ornament, texture, illustration or invented imagery on the page; the only picture is a real bhajan set by the slide itself.
